notes.zh:
### v0.2.0

- 项目评审 6 大块修复（HTTP 鉴权 / Shell & SSRF / Session 隔离 / 调度与持久化 / WebUI 状态机 / Docker & CI）
- 移除 openai 内置 provider 死代码，改用 apiBase 判断
- 修复 Responses API 回归（custom 指向 api.openai.com 仍可启用）

notes.en:
### v0.2.0

- Six-block review fixes (HTTP auth / Shell & SSRF / Session isolation / Scheduling & persistence / WebUI state machine / Docker & CI)
- Remove dead openai builtin provider code, switch to apiBase-based detection
- Fix Responses API regression (custom pointing to api.openai.com still works)
- favicon.svg now self-contained base64-embedded
